document.abstract: The Washington, D.C., Sec-tion’s April meeting took place virtually with an in-depth tour of the new NBC News bureau facility at 400 North Capital Street, just a short distance from Capitol Hill. The Zoom gathering began with Section Chair Maciej Ochman calling the meeting to order and conducting a short business meeting before introducing a panel consisting of three NBC employees, Stacy Brady, Jay Hurt, and Marc Greenstein, who provided information about the new bureau and served as tour guides. Bruce Milton, a member of the studio team at the Department of Homeland Security’s Transportation Security Administration, served as moderator during the virtual activity.
